compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
- DD2: For each unresolved thread, a sonnet sub-agent addresses the concern in code or via REST reply

## Description
Create the prompt template file at `plugins/dso/scripts/prompts/pr-comment-responder.md` consumed by the thread-resolution loop in `merge-to-main-pr.sh`. The template instructs a general-purpose sub-agent (dispatched via `llm-api-call.sh` with model=sonnet) on how to address one PR review thread.

## Files to Modify
- `plugins/dso/scripts/prompts/pr-comment-responder.md` (CREATE)

## Required Sections
The template MUST contain the following sections:
1. `# Role` — "You are addressing a single GitHub PR review thread."
2. `## Inputs` — placeholders: `{thread_id}`, `{thread_body}`, `{pr_url}`, `{repo_root}`, `{file_path}`, `{line_range}`, `{diff_context}`
3. `## Decision Tree` — three branches: (a) actionable code change, (b) actionable via REST reply, (c) unaddressable -> escalate
4. `## Output Contract` — exactly one of three terminal lines:
   - `ACTION:code_change FILE:<path> SUMMARY:<one-line>`
   - `ACTION:reply REPLY:<text>`
   - `ACTION:escalate REASON:<text>`
5. `## Constraints` — must not push, must not commit, must not call gh, must not modify tests outside the file under review

## Justification (Unit Test Exemption)
Per implementation-plan SKILL.md Unit Test Exemption Criteria:
1. No conditional logic — pure declarative template content
2. Any standalone test would be a change-detector
3. Infrastructure-boundary-only — consumed by sub-agent dispatch; behavior verified end-to-end via T1 stubbed dispatch and T4 loop behavior

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] File exists at correct path
  Verify: test -f plugins/dso/scripts/prompts/pr-comment-responder.md
- [ ] All 5 required section headers present
  Verify: for h in '# Role' '## Inputs' '## Decision Tree' '## Output Contract' '## Constraints'; do grep -qF "$h" plugins/dso/scripts/prompts/pr-comment-responder.md || exit 1; done
- [ ] Output contract declares all three ACTION variants
  Verify: grep -c 'ACTION:code_change\|ACTION:reply\|ACTION:escalate' plugins/dso/scripts/prompts/pr-comment-responder.md | awk '$1>=3'
- [ ] All input placeholders declared
  Verify: for p in '{thread_id}' '{thread_body}' '{pr_url}' '{repo_root}' '{file_path}'; do grep -qF "$p" plugins/dso/scripts/prompts/pr-comment-responder.md || exit 1; done

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet to opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
